plotEn: In present-day Paris, Anastasia, a young dancer, joins the prestigious Opéra Garnier. While rehearsing Orpheus—a cursed opera said to have been composed by the Phantom of the Opera—she falls in love with a mysterious pianist. As the opening night approaches, amidst unexplained accidents and unsettling revelations, Anastasia finds herself drawn into an impossible romance that blurs the line between reality and the fantastical.
